HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- Short walk to the Rosemary Beach Access and 4 neighborhood pools
- Access to fitness center and racquet club
- Private heated pool *Pool heating is available October 1-May 1 for $50 per day
- Newly built in 2017 by Benecki Homes and designed by Melanie Turner Interiors
- 6 adult bikes
- Refreshing the living room furniture and the dining room table with Restoration Hardware pieces in Spring 2026
- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout

DETAILS: Retreat for an idyllic coastal escape at Mary Rose Main House, a Rosemary Beach home offering 6 beautiful bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, accommodating 18 guests in unrivaled comfort. This favorite 30A community boasts multiple amenities, including dedicated beach access, 4 neighborhood pools, a fitness center, boutiques, and restaurants, all within a short walk. Imagine afternoons stretched out beside the shimmering private pool or sunbathing along the sprawling Gulf shore—only a 5-minute walk away.

Dressed in soothing blues and crisp whites, this professionally designed home seamlessly blends coastal and modern aesthetics to create a relaxing and luxurious atmosphere. Cypress beams add warmth as guests unwind on the inviting sofa. The deluxe kitchen was curated for large groups, featuring 2 dishwashers, 2 refrigerators, and an adjacent table for 8 with additional seating for 4 at the marble waterfall island. In the attractive courtyard, a large dining table awaits alfresco feasts of fresh-caught seafood, while the gentle sound of the pool’s fountain feature beckons guests to relax on the loungers. When it’s time for bed, this level’s guest bedroom offers an enchanting refuge with a 4-poster king bed, TV, and private bathroom.

The second floor continues to impress with a cypress wood ceiling in the stunning primary bedroom, boasting a writing desk, TV, and balcony access. A guest bedroom with 2 full beds shares the balcony, while the final guest bedroom has a king bed. For ultimate convenience, all the bedrooms on this level feature a private bathroom, and a spacious laundry hosts 2 washers and dryers to keep beach towels fresh.

The third floor invites indoor fun! Challenge loved ones to a friendly ping-pong tournament or screen a new release in the theater room, complete with cozy seating, a wet bar, and 75” TV. Barn doors conceal 2 sleeping nooks—with 1 queen-over-queen bunk in the first, and 1 queen-over-queen bunk and 1 twin-over-twin bunk in the second.

Escape for an indulgent Rosemary Beach vacation at Mary Rose Main House. On-site parking and 6 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore 30A. For beach access, use any of the community access points or the public access at the end of Winston Lane. Don't miss the opportunity to book today!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
FIRST FLOOR:
Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

SECOND FLOOR:
Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate
Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

THIRD FLOOR LOFT:
Bunk Area: Queen-over-Queen Built-in Bunk bed and Twin-over-Twin Built-in Bunk bed together in a private room & Queen-over-Queen Built-in Bunk bed in another private bedroom, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
